sources.title: Patrizio Bertelli: biographical opening
sources.findings: Birth 6 April 1946 in Arezzo; former co-CEO.
sources.caution: Exact birth date is secondary-source only. Infobox co-CEO is stale; education box does not distinguish honorary qualifications. Its 1978 partnership wording differs from official 1977 history.

sources.title: Board of directors: Bertelli and Guerra biographies
sources.findings: Bertelli co-CEO until 26 January 2023; first chair appointment 27 April 2023, current term from 24 April 2024. Florence honorary Business Economics degree 2000, Bologna University Seal 2021. Guerra is CEO.
sources.caution: 2024 is not first chairman appointment; honorary degree and University Seal are not ordinary earned degrees. Other directors biographies must not be assigned to Bertelli.

sources.title: Group history
sources.findings: 1913 origin predates Bertelli; partnership with Miuccia 1977, foundation 1993, sailing challenge launched 1997 for 2000 competition, Hong Kong listing 2011.
sources.caution: Corporate milestones are collective achievements. 1997 project launch is not 2000 race result; do not call him founder of the 1913 house.

sources.title: Historical team biography
sources.findings: Born Arezzo 1946; leather-goods beginnings, supply-chain and retail development. Photo explicitly credited Carlo Borlenghi.
sources.caution: Historical CEO title is outdated. Corporate quality claims remain promotional. No open image reuse license established.

sources.title: Mission and origin
sources.findings: Institution traces creation to 1993 by Miuccia Prada and Patrizio Bertelli; current president/director is Miuccia.
sources.caution: Retain both founders; institutional origin is not a claim about exact legal incorporation date or current Bertelli presidency.

sources.title: 2 December 2025: Versace acquisition completed
sources.findings: Acquisition from Capri completed after regulatory clearances.
sources.caution: Different from April 2025 agreement. Group transaction, not personal acquisition or proof of completed integration. No price used because report search extracts gave inconsistent currencies.

sources.title: 22 October 2026: nine-month revenue update
sources.findings: Direct statement attributed to Bertelli as chairman and executive director about manufacturing investment and volatile markets; revenue period ends 30 September.
sources.caution: A corporate quotation, not independently witnessed attendance. Nine-month revenue is not full-year profit. Prospective market comments not established outcomes.

remainingWork: Obtain a portrait with verified reuse permission and inspect it; seek primary exact birth-date confirmation and refresh office/activity before publication.

portraitReview.credit: Carlo Borlenghi, credited on the historical Luna Rossa biography
portraitReview.unresolved: Original evidence has no portrait. Current board and historical team pages contain photos, but no sufficient open reuse license was established. Commons-targeted search did not identify a licensed candidate. Actual pixels, identity, color and crop not reviewed.
